forensic_atoms.finding: handoff() creates paket_id, builds a deterministic capsule whose first line is HANDOFF <paket_id>, states that this capsule is the text the coordinator gives the delegated subagent, and returns both paket_id and capsule; stern itself does not spawn the child
the versioned donor already routes PreToolUse and PostToolUse through stern.py but has no dedicated SubagentStart/SubagentStop/TaskCreated/TaskCompleted registration
cmd_hook receives the whole hook JSON; current donor handling does not persist tool_use_id or agent_id, so the join is not implemented in donor source today
current Claude Code hook ABI documents PreToolUse/PostToolUse tool_use_id; Agent tool_input.prompt is the delegated task; Agent PostToolUse tool_response.agentId is the child run identifier

new_closed_at_source_abi_level: paket_id -> Agent spawn tool_use_id via exact HANDOFF marker in Agent tool_input.prompt
Agent spawn tool_use_id -> agent_id via the same Agent PostToolUse event's tool_use_id and tool_response.agentId
candidate_join_algorithm: On parent-thread PreToolUse where tool_name == Agent, read tool_use_id and tool_input.prompt.
Parse an exact line marker HANDOFF <paket_id>; accept only exactly one marker.
Verify paket_id exists in entityos_arbeitspaket and is in the expected unresolved state for the same parent session/current package generation.

Append SPAWN_INVOCATION_OBSERVED binding paket_id + package_generation + parent_session_id + spawn_tool_use_id; never infer this edge by time, description similarity, session order or completion order.
On Agent PostToolUse, require the same tool_use_id and read tool_response.agentId; append CHILD_RUN_OBSERVED for that exact WorkExecutionBinding.
If marker count is zero/multiple, package state mismatches, tool_use_id conflicts, or agentId is absent/ambiguous, retain UNKNOWN/CONTRADICTION and do not synthesize a binding.
fail_closed_invariants: HANDOFF marker is an identity carrier, not completion evidence.
The package-to-invocation join is valid only when the marker is inside the actual Agent tool_input.prompt observed for that tool_use_id.
A tool_use_id may not bind to two different paket_id values.
A paket_id may not silently fan out to multiple Agent invocations unless an explicit fanout contract admits that cardinality.
Nested/subagent hook calls must not be confused with the parent spawn call; common hook agent_id presence identifies calls occurring inside a subagent.
task_id remains a separate optional namespace and is not inferred from agent_id or tool_use_id.
No reconcile success follows from spawn/start alone; completion still requires the current typed result-receipt and evidence law.
counterhypotheses: The real coordinator may fail to pass the handoff capsule byte-faithfully into Agent tool_input.prompt.
A deployed Claude Code build may differ from the current documented hook ABI.
A coordinator may accidentally reuse one capsule for multiple Agent calls, creating a cardinality conflict.
Host/user/managed hook composition may differ from repository hooks.json.
